description: This file defines configuration structures, options, and functions for setting up OpenTelemetry HTTP instrumentation, including span creation, propagators, filters, and event recording.

classes.name: config
classes.description: Holds configuration options for HTTP instrumentation, including tracer, meter, propagators, filters, and formatting functions.

methods.name: newConfig
methods.description: Creates a new configuration object, applying provided options, and initializes tracer and meter.

methods.name: WithTracerProvider
methods.description: Sets a custom tracer provider for the configuration.

methods.name: WithMeterProvider
methods.description: Sets a custom meter provider for the configuration.

methods.name: WithPublicEndpointFn
methods.description: Sets a function to determine if a request is a public endpoint for span linking.

methods.name: WithPropagators
methods.description: Sets custom propagators for context propagation.

methods.name: WithFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to exclude certain requests from tracing.

methods.name: WithMessageEvents
methods.description: Configures recording of message read/write events.

methods.name: WithSpanNameFormatter
methods.description: Sets a custom function to format span names.

methods.name: WithClientTrace
methods.description: Sets a function to provide client trace for requests.

methods.name: WithServerName
methods.description: Sets the server name for instrumentation.

methods.name: WithMetricAttributesFn
methods.description: Sets a function to generate metric attributes from requests.
